about: T-431 P2 + P4 (2026-10-21): the SUMMARY's fourth page, reached by R from KNOWN ROUTINES and left by L, its title blank. A 9x9 grid, axes unlabelled -- across GLAD minus SAD (right is glad), up CALM, down AFRAID -- and a dot whose hue is MAD (a cool slate to an ember) and whose saturation is friendship; under it one of the sixteen approved lines of behaviour (DRAFT in the game). Every line is shown once, every 3x3 reading, the friendship variants and the split between them, MAD's three, the corners, a daemon never stamped, an egg (no page), a boxed daemon from the PC, and HALFTONE (grey). Values are written outright with `feel` (stamped now) on the debug scratch save; UP/DOWN moves between daemons on the page and passes over the egg in slot 4.
